turns.assistant_text:
Here are some of the hottest news stories in technology today:

1. **NYSE Chooses Avalanche Ledger Technology**  
   The New York Stock Exchange has selected Avalanche to provide the core ledger technology for its clearing infrastructure. This decision is based on Avalanche's ability to meet the demanding requirements of financial-market infrastructure, including reliability, speed, and cost predictability. [Read more](https://www.marketsmedia.com/nyse-chooses-avalanche-ledger-technology) (Markets Media)

2. **Asian Stocks Rise After Technology Shares Advance on Wall Street**  
   Asian stock markets saw gains following a rise in technology shares on Wall Street. Concerns about potential government restrictions on AI-related products have emerged, but companies like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix reported significant gains. [Read more](https://ca.finance.yahoo.com/news/asian-stocks-rise-technology-shares-072214355.html) (Yahoo Finance)

3. **Student Entrepreneur Helps Take AI Technology from Lab to Marketplace**  
   A student at George Mason University has developed an AI-powered fitness technology that generates personalized exercise routes. This innovation is part of a project called PedalTopia, which combines exercise with interactive gaming. [Read more](https://www.gmu.edu/news/2026-11/student-entrepreneur-helps-take-ai-technology-lab-marketplace) (George Mason University)

4. **Winter Garden Police Introduce AI Technology to Handle Nonemergency Calls**  
   The Winter Garden Police Department has implemented an AI-powered system named AVA to manage nonemergency calls. This technology aims to reduce wait times and allow dispatchers to focus on emergency situations. [Read more](https://www.fox35orlando.com/news/winter-garden-police-introduce-ai-technology-handle-nonemergency-calls) (FOX 35 Orlando)

5. **FFR Forms Strategic Partnerships with California Science and Technology University**  
   FFR, a robotics company, is building an AI ecosystem and has formed partnerships with educational institutions to foster collaboration in robotics and AI development. [Read more](https://autonews.gasgoo.com/articles/news/ffr-forms-strategic-partnerships-with-california-science-and-technology-university-and-others-2120045027581140992) (Gasgoo)

These articles highlight significant developments in the tech industry, from financial technology to AI applications in various sectors.

items.title: NYSE Chooses Avalanche Ledger Technology - Markets Media
items.summary: Financial-market infrastructure has demanding requirements. It must perform reliably through periods of heavy activity, deliver fast and certain settlement, recover cleanly when something fails, and give market operators predictability over capacity and costs as well as meaningful control over the systems their businesses depend on. The technology also has to fit within a complex financial system rather than asking that system to reorganize around it. [...] Those requirements are central to why Avalanche was selected to provide the core ledger technology supporting the platform’s clearing infrastructure. As Dennis Lee, Head of Digital Issuance at NYSE, explained, the ledger responsible for recording and settling trades needs to be fast, reliable, predictable in cost and capable of controlling participation. Avalanche meets those requirements. [...] Millions of people know the New York Stock Exchange. Far fewer think about the technology, clearing systems, data infrastructure and operational machinery that allow modern markets to function, and they aren’t supposed to. Good infrastructure tends to disappear into the experience it enables. The same is true of blockchain as it becomes foundational to global finance.

items.title: Student entrepreneur helps take AI technology from lab to marketplace | George Mason University
items.summary:
Posters in Fuse at Mason Square feature Esmael and encourage people to try PedalTopia. Provided.

 

Yu and his collaborators developed a patented technology that can generate personalized exercise routes based on a user’s workout goals. Called “exertion-aware path generation,” the technology can consider factors such as calories, distance, and resistance when creating a workout and can be applied to gym bikes, treadmills, and rowing machines. [...] The team incorporated the technology into PedalTopia, a game integrated with gym bikes combining exercise with interactive play. Riders can progress through levels, track performance, compete with other players and AI-controlled riders, and follow customized cycling paths. On a stationary bike, resistance can change to correspond to elevation along the generated virtual route. [...] Esmael, a computer science major who is also pursuing a minor in entrepreneurship, has spent more than a year working with Yu on an artificial intelligence (AI)-powered fitness technology. His role extends beyond the technology itself; he also takes on business development responsibilities as the team explores moving the research from the lab to the market.

items.title: Winter Garden police introduce AI technology to handle nonemergency calls | FOX 35 Orlando
items.summary:
Instead of speaking directly with a dispatcher, callers making nonemergency requests will initially interact with an automated voice system.

"Rather than talking to one of our dispatchers, you're going to be talking to an automated voice," said Capt. Mike Mason with the Winter Garden Police Department.

Mason said the department commissioned the technology in February and has been working toward its implementation for several months.

"We're pretty excited about it," he said. [...] #### The Brief

 + Winter Garden police are introducing AVA, an AI-powered system to handle nonemergency calls in Winter Garden, Ocoee, Windermere and Oakland.
  + The technology aims to reduce wait times and free dispatchers to focus on emergencies and officer communications.
  + Callers who need human assistance or become frustrated can still be transferred to a live dispatcher. [...] During a demonstration, AVA could be heard asking a caller for the address of a reported noise complaint.

## Dispatchers can focus on emergencies

Big picture view:

Winter Garden police say the technology will help free up dispatchers to concentrate on emergency calls and radio communications with officers in the field.

Mason said dispatchers often have to manage several responsibilities simultaneously, including incoming telephone calls and radio traffic.
